reason: Passive 4-key keypad modelled as a 1-row x 4-column keypad-matrix with ribbon order R1, C2, C1, C4, C3 taken from Adafruit's PID 1332 pinout image; driver holds the common R1 low and reads pull-up key lines with 20 ms debounce, and the check passed on ESP32 and Pico.
